name: nlp_rnn_tagger
title: A BiLSTM part-of-speech tagger over packed sequences, with the optimizer stepped before the backward pass
origin: hardening round 1, domain-nlp, 2026-09-13 - the pre-transformer sequence-labelling shape
note: Every planted defect that a rule models is found here, in both dataflow modes. That is the point of the program: the loaders are built in the same scope, the criterion is local, and the evaluation function is named evaluate(), so none of the tag-propagation gaps the other NLP programs hit applies.

expected.why: the validation sentences change on every run, so the tag accuracy printed after each epoch is not comparable across runs
each update applies the previous batch's gradients - which were just zeroed - so the first step of every batch is a no-op and the model trains on a one-batch lag for the whole run

expected.defect: the epoch loss accumulates the tensor rather than loss.item()
expected.why: an LSTM's autograd graph is deep, so keeping one per batch alive for a whole epoch is the classic slow out-of-memory
the tagger carries nn.Dropout(0.3) and an LSTM with dropout=0.2, so the validation accuracy printed after every epoch is measured through a randomly thinned network

expected.defect: evaluate() is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: the validation pass builds a full backprop-through-time graph for every sentence and discards it
the split, the embedding initialisation and the dropout masks all move between runs

forbidden.why: optimizer.zero_grad() is the first statement of the batch loop (line 36)
optimizer.step() is called on line 39 - it is in the wrong place, which is MLV203's finding, not missing, which is MLV202's
there is no torch.no_grad() block in this project, so no backward can be inside one
the validation loader passes shuffle=False explicitly (line 29)
neither DataLoader takes num_workers=, and both are built inside a function
the classifier returns raw logits (line 34); nn.CrossEntropyLoss applies the log-softmax itself
no sigmoid and no BCE loss appear in this project
nothing is moved to a device anywhere in this project, so there is no model/batch device mismatch to report
every submodule is assigned directly to an attribute; no plain list or dict of modules exists
torch.save is given model.state_dict() (line 65) and nothing calls torch.load
logits.argmax(dim=-1) on line 51 turns the logits into tag ids before the comparison

unsupported.defect: enforce_sorted defaults to True, so every batch whose sentences are not in descending length order raises at run time - and the loader shuffles, so the first batch is already unsorted
unsupported.why: no rule models the keyword defaults of torch.nn.utils.rnn.pack_padded_sequence; the FQN is not in the knowledge tables at all

unsupported.defect: a two-layer BiLSTM is trained with no gradient clipping anywhere
unsupported.why: MLV210 (recurrent model trained without gradient clipping) is a later-tier rule and is not built

unsupported.defect: PAD_INDEX is 0, which is also a legitimate tag id in TAGS ("O"), so every 'O' token is dropped from the loss
unsupported.why: no rule relates a pad index to a label vocabulary

unsupported.defect: sequence_loss constructs a fresh nn.CrossEntropyLoss on every batch instead of once
unsupported.why: harmless for a stateless loss, but no rule models object construction inside a batch loop
